result.summary: The page is generally well composed, but horizontally scrolling content is visibly clipped at the right edge, making cards and category pills look cut off rather than intentionally contained.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel in “Fastest near you” is cut off on the right: the third restaurant card extends beyond the viewport, truncating its image and name (“Trattoria Piccol…”).
issues.suggestion: Implement the row as a clearly padded horizontal scroll container, or resize cards so whole cards fit within the viewport. Preserve a deliberate partial-card affordance with consistent right padding if horizontal scrolling is intended.

issues.description: The category chip row is also clipped at the far right, showing only part of an additional pill without a clear margin or scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent trailing padding and horizontal-scroll behavior/affordance, or limit the visible chips to fit the screen width.

issues.description: The second “Popular right now” restaurant card is abruptly obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, leaving its image/content visibly cut off at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the bottom navigation height so scrolling can reveal the full final cards above the navigation.
